subject: Follow-up: consumption model + 1M-token unit price check for LumenLytics pilot
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Harrison Cole <harrison@lumenlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: consumption model + 1M-token unit price check for LumenLytics pilot

Hi Harrison — great talking earlier. Quick recap and action items from today's discovery so we have alignment before we put together a formal proforma: 

Summary of what we heard
- Pilot scope: 3-month integration to evaluate Redwood inference for document ingestion + chat UI (inference = generate + embeddings + reranking).
- Expected early-month throughput: 20–60M tokens/month for months 1–3 depending on ingestion ramp.
- Long-term target: 100–300M tokens/month if pilot converts.

Key pricing inputs we need from you (to finalize an invoice estimate)
1) Target unit price you expect or budget for (target $ / 1M tokens). If you have a range please share.
2) Confirm split between chat (generation) vs embeddings (we usually price embeddings differently).
3) Any required SLA/uptime or retention controls that would push to Dedicated/private pricing.

Preliminary options attached: a conservative pay-as-you-go sketch and a committed-monthly-commit sketch with blended $/1M tiers and estimated monthly totals. See attachment: lumen-pilot-costing.xlsx (lightweight).

Immediate next steps
- Harrison: share target $/1M and approximate chat vs embeddings split by EOD Wed.
- Redwood: we will produce a formal proforma with line items (compute, storage, embeddings, request overhead) and a 1‑page summary for procurement. Target to send proforma by Thursday.

Attachments: lumen-pilot-costing.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-pricing-scenarios.csv (CSV)

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

From: Harrison Cole <harrison@lumenlytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: LumenLytics Finance <finance@lumenlytics.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: consumption model + 1M-token unit price check for LumenLytics pilot

Thanks Naomi — good summary. A few quick answers from our side:  

Budget / target unit price
- Our procurement band for proofs-of-concept is roughly $800–$1,200 per 1M gen tokens. For embeddings we expect a lower unit target (~$200–$350 per 1M embeddings tokens), but can be flexible depending on accuracy/SLA.

Estimated volumes
- Pilot months 1–3: 30–60M tokens/month (mostly generation).
- If pilot looks good, we’d expect a phased ramp to ~120–180M tokens/month over 6 months.

Procurement notes
- Finance asked for a line-item proforma and an estimated invoice (pdf) for their purchase order process. They also want a call to clarify billing cadence and refund/credit terms for unused committed tokens.

We can do a procurement sync next Tuesday at 11:00 PT if that works for you and your finance/ops counterpart.

— Harrison
Harrison Cole
Head of Platform | LumenLytics
harrison@lumenlytics.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: consumption model + 1M-token unit price check for LumenLytics pilot

Adding a couple of internal notes so the proforma is actionable for procurement: 
- Include both pay-as-you-go rows and a reserved/committed lineup (3-month pilot commit, then optional 12-month ramp). Show per-1M unit price by tier and a blended effective $/1M based on the 30/60/120 volume scenarios Harrison listed.
- Call out non-token line items: embeddings indexing charges (if we charge separately), storage for KV/cache, and outbound data egress (if applicable).
- Add a short footnote on expected token reduction from prefix caching / batching (we typically model a 10–20% token-saving in early pilots) and how that affects invoice math.

Rishi — can you draft the proforma PDF + a one-page summary and attach the working sheet? Monica, please include CS onboarding estimates so procurement has the total purchase order amount.

Thanks,
Ben

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: consumption model + 1M-token unit price check for LumenLytics pilot

Attached: LL-commit-proforma.pdf (formal proforma), lumen-pilot-costing.xlsx (detailed workbook).

High-level summary of proposed pricing (draft) — see PDF for invoice-ready numbers:
- Pay-as-you-go (no commit): generation $1,350 / 1M tokens; embeddings $380 / 1M tokens.
- Pilot 3-month commit (30–60M/mo range): generator tiered pricing -> $1,050 / 1M (0–50M), $900 / 1M (50–120M). Embeddings tier -> $300 / 1M. Blended effective price at 60M/mo = $970 / 1M.
- 12-month reserved (for later conversion): deeper discounts available; include compute reservation fee and minimum monthly commit.

Notes:
- The workbook models token savings from KV/prefix caching (assume 12% reduction in our conservative scenario) and runtime batching that reduces per-token compute, which is reflected in the blended effective price.
- We separated request-level overhead (per-request base charge) so procurement can see how small/large calls affect cost.

Links & attachments: lumen-pilot-costing.xlsx [Google sheet link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-lumen-pilot] 
Attachment stubs: LL-commit-proforma.pdf (PDF), lumen-pilot-costing.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Solutions Finance | Redwood Inference

From: LumenLytics Finance <finance@lumenlytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Procurement questions re: Redwood proforma

Forwarding questions from our procurement lead:  
1) Do committed tokens roll over if not used during the pilot month? If not, do you offer a partial credit mechanism? 2) Can you split billing between generation and embeddings on the PO? We need separate GL codes.
3) We need the DocuSign flow to be vendor-compliant (we require vendor contact/phone + remit info on the invoice).

Finance also asked you to include a single-line estimated invoice for the pilot (total PO amount) so we can trigger internal approvals.

Attachments: none in this forward (procurement email included).

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Harrison Cole <harrison@lumenlytics.com>, LumenLytics Finance <finance@lumenlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: consumption model + 1M-token unit price check for LumenLytics pilot

Thanks — got the questions. Quick answers below and proposed next steps: 
Answers
- Rollovers: pilot committed tokens do not automatically roll over month-to-month, but we can include a 60% partial credit for unused committed tokens during a short-term pilot (one-time concession) and capture that as a line item on the proforma.
- Billing split: yes — we will present separate line items for generation and embeddings so you can map to separate GL codes.
- DocuSign/invoice: we will include remit address + vendor contact on the invoice PDF and provide a DocuSign document link.

Next steps
- Rishi to update proforma to include the 60% pilot credit line and a single-line total PO amount.
- Naomi to schedule 30-min procurement sync: Tue, Jun 23rd 11:00 PT (proposed). Please confirm availability.

I will send the updated invoice/proforma by end of day Friday so you can circulate it internally.

Best,
Naomi
